profile.headline: Software Development Engineer II at Amazon
profile.summary:
Recent graduate of Montana State University at Bozeman. Received a B.S. degree in Computer Science along with a honors degree. Achieved a distinction of Magna Cum Laude with a GPA of 3.88.

My core strengths include the following:
• Software Engineering
• Site Reliability Engineering
• Backend Development
• Cloud Computing
• Databases
• Code & Release Management
• Iterative Methodologies (Agile/Scrum/Kanban)
• CI/CD, Test Automation

Programming languages include the following:
• Python
• C
• C++
• Go
• Java
• MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Create new features for an internal React web application used to track changes requests for Amazon devices
• Maintain and create UI/integration test suites that run against CI/CD pipelines
• Integrate backend Java APIs and GraphQL resolvers with frontend features
• Resolve operational issues and fulfill program manager requests by participating in an on-call rotation
• Utilize Agile project methodologies day-to-day as a Scrum team member to achieve sprint goals and deadlines
• Mentored three interns tasks to design, test, and develop frontend React features end-to-end

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built and deployed a scalable AWS EC2 Instance Scheduler which resulted in a $40,000 annual cost savings for the company
• Setup continuous integration pipeline that deployed the Instance Scheduler onto an AWS cloud environment
• Performed incremental feature updates for core application backend using Python, Go, and AWS CloudFormation
• Wrote automated test cases in Python and Go as part of a test-driven development build process
• Worked in a collaborative team environment using Jira, Slack, and Google Hangouts
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Python (Programming Language) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Maintained backend core server code written in C/C++ for Oracle’s cloud- and browser-based QA software
• Performed software updates to address code defects by utilizing test-driven development and continuous integration best practices
• Wrote automated test cases in C++ as part of test-driven development build process
• Participated in Scrum ceremonies to include backlog grooming, daily standup, sprint planning and retrospective meetings

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Led weekly meetings and supervised students in Computer Science coursework
• Facilitated and graded programming assignments for thirty students
• Assisted professor in an intro-level C programming course for the Spring 2019 semester
• Assisted professor in an intro-level Python programming course for the Fall 2018 semester

positions.title: SmartyCats Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutored six lower-division Computer Science courses
• Helped solve coding problems and provided feedback for Computer Science students
• Scheduled and met with students three times a week to assist them with Computer Science programming assignments
